design: All4sites and3widths, seed681 matched to682 and683. Hungarian one-to-one matching by decoder subspace overlap mean squared principal cosine. Null: deterministic signed permutation of ambient coordinates of second decoder, then independently optimize assignment. Evaluate validation support Jaccard for both matchings. Test unused.
limitations: Seed stability is not semantic purity, manifold smoothness or causal fidelity. One ambient scramble per pair is a reference not significance test; allblocks and jointlyoccupied subsets reported. Bases allow rotations within blocks.
